description: This file provides a Windows-specific wrapper around filesystem operations, including functions for opening files, creating directories, obtaining file status, and reading symbolic links, all using UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: int fs_win32_openUTF8(const char * path,int oflag,int pmode)
methods.description: Opens a file with a UTF-8 path on Windows using the wide-character API.

methods.name: int fs_win32_mkdirUTF8(const char * path,mode_t mode)
methods.description: Creates a directory with a UTF-8 path on Windows.

methods.name: int fs_win32_stati64UTF8(const char * path,struct fs_win32_stati64UTF8 * st)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed status information of a file or directory specified by a UTF-8 path.

methods.name: int fs_win32_readlinkUTF8(const char * path,char * result,size_t rsz)
methods.description: Reads the target of a symbolic link specified by a UTF-8 path.

ctags.name: fs_win32_openUTF8
ctags.pattern: /^int fs_win32_openUTF8 (const char *path, int oflag, int pmode)$/
